description: Figure 1 is a line plot illustrating how “Similarity” varies across model “Layer” for four language-pair conditions within Qwen1.5-1.8B. The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer layers from 0 to 22 with tick labels shown every 2 layers. The y-axis is labeled “Similarity,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.00 to 0.45 with tick marks at regular 0.05 intervals. Four solid lines without visible point markers are shown: a red line labeled “en&en,” a green line labeled “en&el,” a blue line labeled “en&es,” and a magenta line labeled “en&bn.” The red en&en line starts near about 0.08 at layer 0, rises to a local high around 0.27 near layer 6, stays around roughly 0.16–0.19 through the middle layers, declines to about 0.08–0.10 around layers 19–21, then jumps sharply to about 0.42 at layer 22. The green en&el line begins near about 0.05 at layer 0, increases to around 0.14 near layer 6, remains around roughly 0.11–0.14 across mid layers, dips to about 0.05–0.07 around layers 19–21, and ends with an increase to about 0.25 at layer 22. The blue en&es line starts near about 0.06 at layer 0, peaks around 0.25 near layer 6, stays near roughly 0.15–0.18 across mid layers, drops to about 0.07–0.09 around layers 19–21, and rises to about 0.28 at layer 22. The magenta en&bn line begins near about 0.05 at layer 0, rises to around 0.16 near layer 6, stays around roughly 0.12–0.15 through mid layers, declines to about 0.06–0.08 around layers 19–21, and increases to about 0.30 at layer 22.
